product: Sharing foreign Iceberg tables with OpenSharing is now generally available
tagline: Sharing and reading foreign Iceberg tables with OpenSharing is now generally available.
what_it_does: Sharing and reading foreign Iceberg tables with OpenSharing is now generally available. Providers can share Iceberg tables federated from foreign Iceberg catalogs using Lakehouse Federation, including to recipients using external Iceberg clients. As a recipient, you read data and notebooks shared with you using the Databricks to Databricks OpenSharing protocol, where Databricks manages a secure connection for data sharing.
